title: Verbs, Adjectives, and Expressions with Prepositions
summary: High-frequency verb and adjective constructions that require specific prepositions.
whyItMatters: Fixed prepositional complements are part of the word pattern and determine both meaning and case.

mentalModel.title: Learn one complete unit
mentalModel.content: Store warten auf plus accusative or teilnehmen an plus dative, not the verb alone.

mentalModel.title: Ask with wo(r)- and answer with da(r)-
mentalModel.content: Use worauf/darauf for things and preposition plus wen/wem for people.

ruleBlocks.title: Learn preposition and case together
ruleBlocks.content: Practice sich interessieren für + accusative, helfen bei + dative, and sprechen mit + dative.

ruleBlocks.title: Form questions by reference type
ruleBlocks.content: Ask Worauf wartest du for a thing and Auf wen wartest du for a person.

ruleBlocks.title: Use da-compounds for things
ruleBlocks.content: Answer Ich warte darauf, but Ich warte auf ihn for a person.

tables.title: Prepositional Complement Patterns
rows: Ich kümmere mich um die Technik.
Wir sind stolz auf das Ergebnis.

examples.de: Wer kümmert sich um die Präsentation?
examples.en: Who is taking care of the presentation?

examples.de: Woran arbeitest du gerade? Ich arbeite an der Grafik.
examples.en: What are you working on? I am working on the graphic.

examples.de: Wir freuen uns auf die Zusammenarbeit.
examples.en: We are looking forward to the collaboration.

commonMistakes.wrong: Auf was wartest du? in careful standard usage.

comparisons.summary: Team roles provide frequent fixed prepositional expressions.
Follow-up questions use prepositional question forms.
